tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bde mchog lus dkyil gyi dbang chog bde chen snying po bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lus dkyil gyi dbang chog bde chen snying po zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo che la gus btud nas/ /skal ldan kho na'i spyod yul du/ /rab zab lus kyi dkyil 'khor te/ /de yi dbang bskur cho ga bshad/ /'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams tshogs par byas te/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ sumbhas bsangs/ swa bhas sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ zhes byin gyis rlabs/ phaiṃ zhes mgron rnams spyan drangs/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi nas bha wantu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum/ arghaṃ nas/ shapta 'i bar gyis mchod/ lha yi tshogs rnams nas 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang*/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal na/ dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ bgegs rnams bzlog cing 'dod pa'i don thams cad sgrub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang pa thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig ces dang*/ sumbha bzlas drag rol bya gtor ma phyir dor ro/ /de nas gnas dang yo byad byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ sumbha sa bsangs/ swa bhā sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang hūṃ yig las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du/ bhruṃ las byung ba'i gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/

zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las gyur pa/ ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba/ yul nam mkha'i mthas khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du bla ma dang dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ badzra arghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badzra pā dyaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du/ dhu pe/ a lo ke gandhe/ nai bi te/ shapta āḥhūṃ/ oṃ sarba bid pu ra pu ra su ra su ra ā brta ya ā brta ya hoḥ oṃ badzra spha ra ṇī khaṃ/ oṃ badzra gtaṇḍe ra ṇi ti/ pra ra ṇi ha/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba buddha kṣe tra pra tsa li te/ pra dzñā pa ra mi ta na da sambha we ta badzra dharma hri da ya ni santo ṣa ni hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho ho ho a khaṃ swāhā/ zhes pas rol mo byin dbab bo/ /de nas cho ga dngos la 'jug par bya ste/ 'di la lnga/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa bdag bskyed dang*/ dbang rdzas sgrub pa bum bskyed dang*/ dbang gi gzhi dkyil 'khor khyad par du bya ba dang*/ dbang bskur len zhing sbyin pa dang*/ rjes chog lha mnyes par byed pa'o/ /dang po ni skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bzlas pa'i mthar thug par sgrub thabs bzhin du nyams su len pa las/ mchod pa'i skabs su/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo rig ma bcu drug gi tshig bcad sogs nag po lugs kyi dkyil chog tu bshad pa ltar ci rigs pa blang zhing*/ spro na bstod pa yang*/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyi gzhug tu bskal pa'i me 'bar ma sogs ci rigs pa sbyar ro/ /bzlas pa grub ma thag tu sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma yang 'bul lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs padma'i steng du āḥlas zla ba'i gdan/

de'i steng du bhruṃ las rin po che'i bum pa lto ba ldir zhing*/ mgrin pa phra ba mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyi mgul chings dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus su/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka ind+ra nī la ltar 'bar ba'i nas me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i thugs ka'i dbus su hūṃ las dpal he ru ka ste nas/ rgyan dang bcas thugs ka'i phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi las shar du maṃ las nas/ me ri 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /mtshams bzhi bum pa bzhi nas/ gang ba dang bcas par gyur/ spyi bo pulli rā na la yar nas/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khyud pa'o/ /thugs ka'i phyi skor gyi 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du khwa gdong ma nas/ bzhugs pa'o/ / rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ yig gi 'od zer nas/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyang rang la thim gyi bar ye shes spyan 'dren dang dbang bskur rgyas gdab byas/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo rig ma bcu drug rnams sngags dang phyag rgya tsam gyis mchod nas/ gzungs thag nas bzung ste/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po gnyis ci 'grub tu bzlas pa'i mthar/ oṃ sumbha sogs nyer gcig tsam bzlas/ yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol nas/ bdag cag slob mar bcas pa la dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ oṃ āḥhūṃ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis lha rnams 'dod chags chen po'i mes byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur zhes brjod/ gsum pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'phros pa'i 'od zer rnams zhes pa nas/ shapta 'i bar dang*/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod de tshogs zhing gi skabs bzhin no/ / bdag nyid 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa/ slob dpon gyi sku'i dkyil 'khor dang gnyis su med par 'dres te/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi rang bzhin du gyur/

dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas/ rang nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par byung nas phyi rol tu 'dug par mos la dbang blang bar bya'o/ /'di ni bla ma'i man ngag ste/ gzhung gi dngos bstan la mi gsal mod/ dngos grub 'byung ba'i dgos pa chen po dang ldan zhing*/ gzhung gi dgongs pa la yang gnas par nges so/ /bzhi pa la gnyis kyi dang po bdag 'jug ste/ de yang dbang gi cho ga ni/ grub chen nyid kyi gzhung sgra ji bzhin pa las/ gzhan gyi kha skongs ye med kyang*/ rang gzhan dbang bskur gnyis ka la shin tu go chod pa skyon bral yon tan thams cad ldan pa yin no/ /'on kyang cung zad spros pa la mos pa rnams la/ rang lugs dang mi 'gal zhing skabs su bab nges pa'i sgo nas gzhan gyi kha 'gengs byed na/ lugs gnyis te/ kha 'gengs pa sdus pa tsam byed pa kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī'i man ngag dang*/ kha 'gengs rgyas par byed pa lo paṇa gzhan gyi lugs gnyis las/ spros pa/ nyung ngu'i cho ga 'di'i rigs la snga ma legs tshabs che bas phal cher de'i lugs dang mthun par bya'o/ /de yang 'jug pa'i dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ / byang chub chen po'i tshul ston pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /sdom pa rnams kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar ba chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ /de bzhin phag mo he ru ka /gsang ba'i gnas dang nye gnas sogs/ /lus la rnam gnas bshad du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ gong nas gong ma'i sdom pa ni/ bu khyod kyis ni bzung bya ste/ grol ba'i rgyu ni de las gzhan/ /thabs ni ci yang yod ma yin/ / zhes sdom pa bsgrags/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs kyis thun mong gi sdom pa bzung*/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang

sogs kyi rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung*/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ zhes pa nas nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs pa bsrung gi bar gyis thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa bzung ngo*/ /phyi ma 'di pham thing ba dang*/ su ma ti'i rjes 'brang rnams mdzad kyi/ shākya shrī'i lugs la mi mdzad do/ /gang ltar yang mi 'gal bas lag len 'dam kha yin mod byed pa legs so/ / oṃ tsakṣur bandha ba rā ya na ya hūṃ/ gis mig dar bcings/ ā khaṃ bī ra hūṃ gis me tog bzung*/ rang gi snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od 'phro ba/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i byang chub sems kyi bdag nyid do/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta u pa da ya mi/ snying gar rdo rje btad la/ su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ/ ho siddhi badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlabs par 'gyur gyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /hūṃ dzaḥhūṃ/ zhes lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi drung du phyin par mos/ de yan chad ni kha skong ngo*/ /de nas dam bzhag ni/ bdud rtsi lce thog tu bzhag ste/ 'di ni bu khyod bdud rtsi ste/ /ma bsrungs sreg par byed pas dug /bsrungs na dngos grub 'gyur ba ste/ /bdud rtsi lnga'i chus 'grub bo/ oṃ pañtsa a mri ta ud da ka ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥhūṃ/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ khyod kyi he ru ka dpal nga*/ khyod kyis brnyes par mi bya zhing*/ /dam tshig dang 'gal mi bya ste/ /dmyal la sogs par 'gro 'gyur ro/ / zhes dam la bzhag ste/ tshig rkang phyi ma ni/ dang por dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur/ zhes bcos na bde'o/ / dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ rang nyid he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs par gyur/ slob dpon gyi sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad dpal he ru ka rig ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang*/ 'khor lo gsum gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ lus kyi stod kyi cha la thugs kyi 'khor lo pa rnams nag po'i rnam pas thim/ bar gyi cha la gsung gi 'khor lo pa rnams dmar po'i rnam pas thim/ smad kyi cha la sku'i 'khor lo pa rnams dkar po'i rnam pa 'jug cing*/ gtso bo'i rig ma bcas pa dang*/ de ma yin pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa yang ba sbu'i bu ga nas zhugs shing snying gar thim par gyur/ oṃ tiṣṭha ma hā kro dha a be sha ya hūṃ/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ya bid ma he bi bya rā dzā ya/ dhī ma he swāhā/ zhes bzla ste/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas nas dbab bo/ /spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag ste/ tiṣṭha badzra zhes brtan par bya/ oṃ pra titstsha badzra ho zhes lus dkyil gyi gtso bo me tog phul/ oṃ tra ti gṛhṇa st+waṃ i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ zhes me tog rang gi spyi bor bcings/ oṃ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ badzra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hri/ zhes mig dar bsal te/ me tog 'bul ba dang mig dar dkrol ba yang kha skong yin no/ /de nas blta bar bskul ba ni/ rang bzhin gyis ni dag pa'i bdag /lus 'di rang bzhin dri ma med/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang mo'i gnas/ /dkyil 'khor la ni bu khyod ltos/ / zhes so/ /de nas lha ngo bstan pa ni/ slob dpon gyi sku'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad mngon sum bzhin du mthong bar gyur/

'di thams cad kyang byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyi bdag nyid do/ / zhes pa'am/ cung zad rgyas pa la mos na/ lus rjes su dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni nas/ gshin rje 'joms ma'o zhes pa'i bar brjod do/ /de dag ni 'jug pa'i bya ba'o/ /dbang dngos la/ bum dbang gsang dbang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang de kho na nyid kyi dbang ste bzhi las/ dang po la/ chu cod pan rdo rje bdag po/ ming dbang*/ sngags dbang*/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs/ spyod pa'i brtul zhugs/ dbugs dbyung ba/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang ste bcu las/ dang po dgu po sdoms nas thun mong gi dbang zhes bya ste/ de ltar na thun mong gi dbang dgu zhu ba'i don du maṇḍal phul la/ chos bden bdag nyid bsam mi khyab/ /bdag la dbang ni bskur du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum mo/ /bdag dang dbang rdzas sumbha sa bsangs shing*/ yungs kar dang bum chu sogs kyis gtor ro/ / bdag nyid skad cig gis rigs thams cad kyi bdag po sangs rgyas kun gyi rigs gcig pu pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro thugs rdo rje he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum gyis 'khyud cing*/ padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa'i skur gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka'i rnam par phaiṃ/ zhes spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod do/ /'dir thun mong gi dbang thams cad la/ rang nyid rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rnam pa 'di kho na la gnas shing*/ dbang rdzas lha so so'i rnam par 'pho ba yin la/ dbang drug po thams cad la/ dbang rdzas lhar bskyed ye shes pa stim/ lha bzhu dbang bskur brtan byed pa/ /bde gshegs bstims nas mchod pa 'bul/ /so so'i dag pa brjod pa'o/ /chu dbang la brtan byed logs pa mi dgos shing*/

dbang rdzas kyi lha bzhugs pa'i rjes su dbang lha spyan 'dren/ mchod pa gsol gdab rnams lhag po yin la/ brtul zhugs la brtan byed man chad mi dgos so/ /de nas chu dbang ni/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu'am/ lha bum mang du yod na thams cad kyi bum chu thod par bsdus/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po g.yas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ thod pa'i 'phreng ba'i cod pan can/ rang 'od kyi yum dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' mi bskyod pa spyan drangs/ phaiṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ dbang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa yab yum rjes chags kyi sbyor bas zhu ste bdud rtsi'i chur gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor phaiṃ

zhes spyan drangs/ puṣpe sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa khyed rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dkyil 'khor ba rnams dang*/ dbang gi lha'i gtso bos dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ sgo mtshams ma rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ dpa' bo rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ dpa' mo rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu blangs/ rdo rje phag mo snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang bcas pas ḍā ma ru dang bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs/ 'khor rnams kyis rol mo'i sgra bsgrags/ me tog gi char phab ste shis pa brjod par gyur/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra sogs/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis tshigs bcad gsum dang*/ nyin mo bde legs= sogs brjod/ rol chen bya/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ oṃ tri tsakra bī ra st+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis mi bskyod pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ ba spu'i bu ga nas zhugs pas/ lus thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rdul phra rab kyis gang bar gyur/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūṃ/ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de ltar na chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam shes gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ /mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel legs par sgrigs pa yin no/ / des rigs 'gres te cod pan sogs bzhi dang*/ rdo rje brtul zhugs kyi bar du shes par bya ba las/ 'di man chad la/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha zhes pa nas rol chen bya/ zhes pa'i bar dbang lha spyan 'dren dang*/ shis brjod mi dgos so/

/'don pa bsgyur te cod pan gyi dbang ni/ swa bha wa/ dbang rdzas rin po che'i dbu rgyan mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las aṃ las rin po che aṃ gis/ rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po g.yas rin po che dang = ye shes sems dpa' rin chen 'byung ldan= yab yum rjes chags kyi= rin po che'i dbu rgyan du gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa khyed rnams kyis/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra warṇā nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes dbu rgyan dar dpyangs dang bcas pa skon spro zhing nus na 'khor lo lnga'i lha thams cad kyi sngags kyang brjod do/ /oṃ tri tsakra bī ra nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu rgyan/ de ltar na dbu rgyan gyi nga rgyal dang ser sna tshor ba mnyam nyid ye shes rin chen 'byung ldan gyi go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba' ི sogs so/ /rdo rje'i dbang ni/ dbang rdzas rdo rje dzri las padma dzriṃ/ 'od dpag med dmar po padma dang ye shes sems dpa' 'od dpag med rdo rje gyur/ he ru ka dpal sogs kyis/ deng khyod bdag por dbang bskur ltar/ /'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rab tu grub phyir rdo rje long*/ /rdo rje lag pa g.yas pas bzung nas snying gar btod/ tri tsakra sogs sngar bzhin/ chu dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu rgyan/ rdo rje 'dod chags 'du shes so sor rtog pa'i ye shes 'od dpag tu med pa'i sogs 'don pa spo/ dril bu'i dbang ni/ dbang rdzas kyi dril bu khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ/ don yod grub pa ljang khu ral gri dang ye shes sems dpa' don yod grub pa dril bur gyur/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /dril bu'i sgra kun rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed/ /oṃ badzra*/ ṇḍe āḥ.āḥ rdo rje dril bu snying gar 'khyud la/ thabs dang shes rab kyi rigs mtha' dag gi bdag po zung du 'jug pa'i rang bzhin rdo rje mkha' 'gro rang snang gi yum dang bcas pa lha sku bde ba chen por mos la/

'khor lo gsum bdag dpa' bo yi/ / lag tu rdo rje dril bu bzung*/ /rang bzhin gyis mdzes dga' ba ni/ /phyag rgya chen por byin gyis rlabs/ /brtan byed chu dbang don yod grub pas dbu rgyan/ dril bu'i dbang*/ phrag dog 'du byed/ bya ba sgrub pa'i don yod grub pa'i zhes 'don pa spo'o/ /ming gi dbang ni/ gzhung las/ slob ma'i spyi bor lag pa sbyin zhes pa tsam las ma gsungs shing*/ nag po'i dkyil chog la jo bo rje'i man ngag sbyar ba las kyang*/ slob ma'i spyi bor slob dpon gyi lag pa bzhag la/ spy-i bor rnam snang bskyed pa tsam ma gtogs dbang rdzas ma mdzad/ kha che lugs la dbang rdzas me tog 'phreng ba la byed/ gzhan phal cher gyi lugs la rdo rje'i dril bu bsnol ba dbang rdzas su mdzad pa/ de dag gang ltar byas kyang 'dra mod/ 'dir kha che lugs ltar bya ste/ dbang rdzas me tog 'phreng ba/ padma dang zla ba'i steng du bhūṃ las 'khor lo bhruṃ/ rnam par snang mdzad dkar po 'khor lo dang ye shes sems dpa' rnam par snang mdzad me tog 'phreng bar gyur/ oṃ tri tsakra a dhī pa ti shrī he ru ka bī ra st+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ badzra na maḥ.a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye/ dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya'o/ /rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu rgyan/ brtan byed chu dbang*/ ming gi dbang*/ gti mugagazugs phung chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes rnam par snang mdzad kyi zhes 'don pa spo'o/ /sngags kyi dbang ni/ me tog gtor zhing*/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ / bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ / lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba byung*/ bdag gi snying gar thim/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po tshar gsum rjes bzlos byas par mos/ me tog spyi bor gtor la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ / rdo rje brtul zhugs ni/ dbang rdzas rdo rje padma dang zla ba'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje rdo rje sems dpa'/

dkar po rdo rje dang*/ ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje sems dpa'/ dang por rdo rje gyur/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /he ru ka dpal phyag na gnas/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan/ / zhes lag pa g.yas pas bzung*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha e ṣa st+waṃ/ dha ra ya mi badzra satwa hrīḥ hi hi hi hi hūṃ/ zhes snying gar bzung*/ de kho nas 'grub bo/ /spyod pa'i brtul zhugs ni/ hūṃ las byung ba'i cang te'u/ thod pa/ kha ṭwaṃ gatshangs skud rnams gtso bo yab yum gyi ngo bor gyur/ he ru ka dpal phyag rgya 'di/ /phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas/ kha ṭwaṃ cang te'u lhung bzed sbyin/ /dpa' bo chen bo blang bar gyis/ / dbugs dbyung zhing lung bstan pa ni/ gtso bos phyag g.yas pa skyabs sbyin dang*/ g.yon chos gos kyi grwa ri dwags kyi rna ba lta bu bzung ste lung bstan par mos/ 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid khyod/ /rang nyid sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /he ru ka dpal zhes bya ba'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid yin no/ /shrī he ru ka ḍā ki ni nā maḥ sarba ta thā ga tā sidhya sa ma ya bhur bhu wa swāḥ khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che/ /dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas/ / bdud tshogs kun las rnam rgyal zhing*/ /grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin/ zhes pa'o/ /de nas phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur che/ /dpa' bo chen po bdag la stsol/ /'gro ba mtshan ma med byed pa/ / de ni da 'dir mdzad du gsol/ / lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ dbang stegs rin po che'i khri'i gdan gyi stengs su/ padma dang zla ba'i gdan la rang nyid gnas par gyur/ steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can/ g.yas su rgyal mtshan/ g.yon du ba dan mtha' skor du mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pas yongs su bskor bar gyur/

rang gi gdod ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor skad cig de nyid la gsal bar gyur pa ni/ zhes pa nas/ rnams kyi bdag nyid do/ /de ltar gyur pa'i bdag nyid he ru ka zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis par gyur/ zhes pa'am/ de tsam bsgom pa mi bde na phyag gnyis pas rung ngo*/ / rtsa la la na dang*/ ra sa na'i 'khor dang bcas shing*/ zhes pa nas/ rdo rje'i phreng bas mtshan pa'i bar lus dkyil rdzogs pas gsal btab ste/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo thugs ka'i hūṃ yig gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i zhes pa nas/ yo ga shuddho3 haṃ/ gi bar mngon rtogs bzhin/ dkyil 'khor pa rnams dang*/ dbang gi lha nas byung ba sbyin par bya/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po mang du brjod/ oṃ tṛ tsakra nas chu lhag ma yar lud de phyi nang lha so so'i spyi bor 'khyil pa yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams dang*/ phyogs bcus dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad rang nyid la gnyis su med par thim/ spyi bor me tog dor la/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzre swāhā/ zhes rab gnas bya/ de nas chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas bdag nyid la mchod/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/ gzhan yang bza' bca' dang na bza' la sogs pa mchod pa sna tshogs pas mchod par gsungs pa ltar yid kyis mos/ de nas 'di ltar/ de nyid rig pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /mi bya ba ni cung zad med/ /de nyid shes nas de nas ni/ /dpa' bos 'dod pa lnga spyad do/ /bdag nyid dpa' bo kun gyi dngos/ /bdag nyid lha mo kun rang bzhin/ /de phyir bdag gis thams cad bya/ /bdag nyid he ru ka dpal mchod/ /rten zhing 'brel bar 'byung chos can/ /sems can sgyu ma'i rang bzhin no/ /khams gsum de ltar shes nas ni/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ / zhes bka'i gnang ba sbyin no/ / de ltar na rdo rje slob dpon mchog gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob pas/

lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed pa'i rim pa sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ / gsang dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul/ skyob med skyob pa skyabs med skyabs/ /dpal ni 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog /rgyu med par ni thugs rje che/ /mgon med bdag gi mgon mdzod cig /bdag nyid che khyod ji lta bar/ /gtso bo bdag kyang de ltar mdzod/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs su ni/ / bying ba bdag la skyabs mdzod cig / mig dar bcings/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis bdud rtsi gtor/ dkyil 'khor gyi bdag mo'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par aḥdamar po/ snying gar hūṃ sngon po/ lte ba'i bar swā ser po/ gsang bar hā ljang khu rnams su gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bla ma he ru ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgra dang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab yum gyi sku la zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ gsang bar lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes brtan par byas pa'i thabs kyi byang chub kyi sems bdag gi lce thog tu bzhag /'di ste dpa' bo lha mo rnams/ /dam tshig rmad byung chen po ste/ khams lnga ldan par ros rtogs byed/ / bde ba gang de myang bar byos/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bdud rtsi myang*/ a ho ma hā su khaṃ/ slar yang yum gyi byang chub kyi sems bdag gi khar phab/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur/ /de bzhin du ni byang chub sems/ /bzang pos bu khyod dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes slar yang bdud rtsi myang*/ de ltar na bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob pas ngag gi dri ma dag lam rang lus thabs ldan gyi rdzogs rim sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i sogs brjod/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul/

gsang dbang ltar gsol ba btab/ mig dar bcings/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis bdud rtsi gtor/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rig ma dngos grub kyi don du phyag rgyar btad/ lha mo 'di ni phyag rgya che/ /mtha' yas bde ba sbyin pa mo/ /rnam pa kun tu phyag rgya long*/ /bu yis bla med mchod par gyis/ /rig ma des kyang 'di skad du/ /dpa' bo byang chub sems bza' bar/ khyod ni spro ba yin nam ci/ /rigs lnga las ni byung ba yi/ /rig ma mchod par rtag gus sam/ /dri chen dri chu stobs dang khrag / sogs bza' da lta yid ches sam/ /rjes su mthun smros dam tshig bzang*/ /ji ltar dga' bar smros shig bu/ / zhes dris pa la/ ji ltar gsungs pa'i dam tshig sogs/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /bud med rtag gus cis mi byed/ /padmar mchod pa cis mi bgyi/ / zhes lan btab/ des kyang skye gnas mchog gi rtsa gsal bar byas nas/ padma bhañdza ho/ zhes pang du byon/ rang nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis pa dang rig rdo rje phag mor gyur/ yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ dkar po nas/ rgyas shing brtan par gyur gyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gis gdong g.yogs dkrol/ gtso bo'i phyag g.yon rang gi spyi bor bzhagaslob dpon dang shes rab mas gsungs par bsam te/ deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyis/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /rmi lam 'dra bar sems can gyi/ /don kun bdag nyid kun gyis kye/ /de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pas sems kyi dri ma dag /lam dngos dang ye shes kyi rig ma bsten pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i sogs brjod/ dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇḍal phul/ gong bzhin gsol ba 'debs pa'am/ khyod zhabs padmo'i bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*/

/bdag la bka' drin skyabs tu gsol/ / 'di la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'di skad ces/ 'di ni rang nyid mdzes ma ste/ /phyi rol yul ni spangs pa'o/ /rig 'di bor nas 'di las ni/ /gzhan pa'i thabs kyis sangs rgyas med/ /rig ma'i brtul zhugs spyod cig bu/ /brtul zhugs kun gyi bla ma'i bla/ / zhes don dam pa'i rig ma'i brtul zhugs sbyin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ bzhi pa dngos te/ lhan cig skyes pa mi zad pa/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mtha' yas sogs/ /de ni brtan 'gro g.yo bdag nyid/ /bdag med nyid kyi bdag tu gnas/ / zhes pa'i don la mnyam par bzhag na/ dpa' bos bde ba chen po rtogs zhes pa'i don yang grub pa yin no/ / de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dgalam bsam gyi mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /gtso bos ji ltar/

sogs lan gsum/ bka' drin gtang rag gi don du maṇḍal phul/ deng nas brtsams te= sogs lan gsum dang dge ba bsngo/ gnyis pa slob ma la dbang bskur ba ni/ slob ma khrus byas gral du 'khod pa la/ thog mar bgegs dang sdig pa sbyang ba bya ste/ gtor ma'am mtheb kyu gsum dang*/ ting lo chang bu rnams kyang gsum gsum 'dus byas la/ bgegs gtor bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum byin gyis rlabs/ gtor ma'am mtheb kyu gsum po bskor la/ oṃ sarba bighnaṃ bhyaḥn maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyoḥbi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ ud ga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhṇa daṃ ba liṃ te swāhā/ zhes lan gsum/ 'dir bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim nas/ phan pa dang bde ba'i sems dang ldan pas gzhan du dengs shig /zhi bas sbyang ba'o/ / oṃ sumbha sogs lan gsum bzlas shing rdo rje gsor la/ ting lo dang chang bu bskor/ 'dir bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa de thams cad gtor ma lam rngan/ ting lo lam sgron/ chang bu lam rgyags kyi tshul du khyer la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig ces pas ni zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba'o/ /hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya byas la bden stobs brjod te/ mthar drag po'i mtsham rngam rol chen dang bcas pas bskrad pa ni/ 'di ltar/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang rgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyis bka' bden dang*/ chos kyi bka'= dge 'dun gyi bka'= chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bden pa dang*/ kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis 'dir dbang gi las la 'jug pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag deng dpal he ru ka'i bka' thos pas/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par myur ba nyid du song shigagang dag mi 'gro ba de dag thams cad dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje dang*/

rdo rje kha ṭwaṃ ga 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar bags par bya'o/ / zhes bgegs bskrad cing gtor ma phyi rol du dor/ drag po sbyang ba'o/ /sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ til dang me dang chu rnams 'dus byas la/ bdag gzhan sems thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad snying gar yi ge baṃ gyi rnam par gnas pa/ lte ba'i gtum mo 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis ded te/ sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur pa mdun gyi til la thim/ bsangs sbyangs/ 'bar ba'i me'i nang du khro bo rdo rje mkha' gro rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa zhal gdangs pa'o/ /oṃ badzra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bha smi ku ru swāhā/ lan gsum brjod/ las kyi rdo rjes til g.yas g.yon du bskor nas/ g.yas su me dang g.yon du chu dor bas/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i zhal du gsol ba dang*/ rgya mtsho chen por sgyur bar bsam/ mthar me yang chu nang du lugs so/ /de nas me tog bkye bsdu dang*/ sems bskyed gsal 'debs sogs byas nas/ gong du ji skad bstan pa'i bdag 'jug las/ rang nyid ces pa rnams khyed rang gi zhes 'don pa spos pas phal cher 'grub la/ lha ngo bstan pa'i skabs/ slob dpon gyi gdod ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor skad cig de nyid la zhes pa nas/ me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /rtsa la la na dang*/ ra sa na/ zhes pa nas/ rdo rje 'phreng bas mtshan pa'o yi bar rnams mngon rtogs bzhin sgom du 'jug dgos pa las/ 'khor gyis sa bon rnams dor ro/ /de rjes spro zhing nus na/ byang phyogs so bdun gyi dag pa rgyas pa zhig brjod na legs so/ /gzhan khyad par phra mo rnams ni slob dpon gyi gsung las rtogs par bya'o/ /lnga pa rjes kyi cho ga lha mnyes par byed pa ni/ nges par tshogs kyi 'khor los bsgrub par bya ba yin la/ rigs ldan ma mchod pa'i cho ga dang*/

zhing skyong la gtor ma sbyin pa sogs 'grub na'ang legs so/ /bla ma gong ma 'ga' zhig ni/ dbang bskur ba'i mdun bskyed kyi tha snyad mdzad nas/ bum bskyed kyi sngon du maṇḍal sgrub mchod re mdzad pas 'dug na'ang*/ lus dkyil 'khor gyi dbang gi don du de 'dra dgos pa ni ma yin zhing*/ skabs 'di dag sogs su yang nges par dgos pa min kyang*/ mchod pa dang bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi don du 'gyur bas byas kyang 'gal ba ni med do/ /de bzhin du sbyin bsregs la sogs pa yang ste/ dbang po dman pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi rgyur shes par bya'o/ /dbang po mchog la ni 'dir mi bzhed de/ dbang bskur ba'i don du yang phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor mi 'bri na/ phyi rol mchod pa dang*/ me mchod tsam gyi don la lta smos kyang mi dgos so/ /de la bya ba'i mthar mchod pa bshams shing byin gyis rlabs/ bdag bskyed dang bum bskyed kyi lha la dmigs nas/ phyi mchod nang mchod gsang mchod bstod pa rnams bya/ yig brgya dang bzod gsol rnams kyang byas nas/ mgron rnams oṃ badzra muḥ zhes gshegs/ bum pa'i lha yo ga shuddho 'i sngags kyis rang la bstim/ de nas nyer bsdu'-i rnal 'byor dang*/ bsrung ba'i rnal 'byor sgrub thabs bzhin bsgom/ de rjes smon lam dang bkra shis ci 'grub bya ste/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdu'o/ /'di la dang por shoms ni/ bris sku la sogs pa rten gyi mdun du bum gdan la bum pa mgul bcings kha rgyan mchod yon gyi snod gzungs thag rdo rje dang bcas pa spyi dang 'dra bar bshams/ 'di la las bum ni mi dgos la/ lha bum drug gam bdun nam lnga'am dgu'am rnam rgyal bum pa gcig pur bsdu ba gang ltar byas kyang rung zhing*/ bum pa mang du byung na'ang rnam pa gcig tu bzang mod kyi/ deng sang gcig la bsdu ba la lag len gtso bor byed do/ /bum pa mang ba'i phyogs la 'khor lo so so'i lha'i snying po yang bzla dgos so/

/de'i mdun du bum pa'i sgos mchod dang*/ gtor mchog gi sgos mchod gnyis/ de'i mdun du spyi'i mchod pa chen mo bshams/ de tsam ma 'grub na mchod pa gcig bshams te yang yang kha gso/ de'i mdun du stegs bu la gtor ma bshams te/ rten gyi g.yon du 'jig rten 'das gtor dang*/ g.yas su 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma'o/ /slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu nang mchod kyi snod ji ltar 'os pa'i sar mig dar me tor dbu rgyan rdo rje dril bu me tog 'phreng ba khwa ṭwaṃ ga gsang dbang la dgos pa'i dam rdzas kyi snod gnyis rnams cung zad khebs kyi bkab nas bzhag go /gzhan yang rol mo sna tshogs pa dag kyang sta gon bya/ sngon 'gro gtor ma yang 'dus byas te bzhag go /kun las rab tu zab pa yi/ /dga' chen khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor gyi/ /dbang chog snying po tsam bris pas/ /'gro kun bde chen gnas thob shog /ces pa dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lus dkyil gyi dbang chog bde chen snying po zhes bya ba 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nags rgyal gyi dben gnas su sbyar ba'o// //maṅga laṃ// //zhus dag/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/bde mchog lus dkyil gyi dbang chog bde chen snying po bzhugs/ -PAGE 298--PAGE 299--PAGE 280-
